findings.claim: No test row has leading or trailing blank space in the body of an other + text/* file, so dropping the trim on the raw path survives.
findings.impact: A later edit can change `raw.trim()` to `raw` for source files and no test fails. Today the only visible effect is blank lines at the top of a card for a file that starts with newlines (whitespace-pre-line keeps them), and the card already shows only a few lines. That is a cosmetic, silent change in normal use.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/TextThumbnail.tsx:85 sets `isOffice || showsRaw ? raw.trim() : stripPreviewText(raw)`. Every other + text/* body in frontend/src/components/__tests__/sourceCardExcerptText.test.tsx (the rows table) starts with a non-blank character and ends with one, so `expected === body` with or without the trim.
findings.repro: Mutant: TextThumbnail.tsx:85 -> `setText(isOffice ? raw.trim() : showsRaw ? raw : stripPreviewText(raw))`. Every row in sourceCardExcerptText.test.tsx still compares equal. Predicted to survive (not run).

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariants file exists. This is a test-strength gap for one behavior.md sentence ('with only leading and trailing blank space trimmed'), not a defect a user hits today.

findings.claim: The predicate `file_type === "other" && mime startsWith "text/"` is written twice, once in showsTextExcerpt and again in showsRawExcerpt, and nothing ties the two together.
findings.impact: Suppose a later edit widens showsTextExcerpt to admit another bucket with a text/* mime, or changes how `other` is decided. TextThumbnail would then silently send the newly admitted files through stripPreviewText, which is the r1 F1 mangling again, and only for the files that edit touched. No user can hit this today. It is a divergence risk.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/lib/textExcerpt.ts:17-18 (`text/*` branch, `document || other`) and frontend/src/lib/textExcerpt.ts:23-26 (`other && text/*`) state the same condition separately. TextThumbnail.tsx:71 decides the transform on its own, apart from the gate the surfaces use (FileCard.tsx:75, FileListRow.tsx:87, JustifiedFileCell.tsx:63).

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant is declared and the current behavior matches behavior.md. This is a maintainability risk, not a wrong result today.

findings.proposed_fix: Express the transform as the complement inside one helper (for example `excerptKind(file): 'raw' | 'cleaned' | 'office' | null`) so the gate and the transform come from one decision.

specification_compliance: r1 F1 is fixed. TextThumbnail.tsx:85 now trims other + text/* bodies and leaves them otherwise unchanged. document + text/* still goes through stripPreviewText, and Office still uses the backend extract. This matches behavior.md 'What the excerpt says'.
r1 F2 is fixed. sourceCardExcerpt.test.tsx adds a `subtitle + text/vtt -> false` row, so the allowlist-to-denylist mutant of textExcerpt.ts:18 is now killed on all three surfaces.
The gate table in behavior.md still matches showsTextExcerpt (textExcerpt.ts:15-21) row by row.
The existing TextThumbnail.test.tsx fixture `note()` is file_type document (line 13), so the clip-frontmatter tests still go through stripPreviewText and are unaffected by the raw path.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The 1 KiB Range window can cut a multi-byte UTF-8 character at the end, which then shows as a replacement character on the last line of a source excerpt. This is pre-existing for documents, and the spec scopes out only non-UTF-8 files, not a truncated trailing character.
regression_risks: Raw excerpts keep interior indentation in textContent, but whitespace-pre-line collapses it visually. decisions.md records this as accepted.

The effect deps of TextThumbnail now include file.file_type. fetchedRef is never reset, so a change of file_type on the same mounted component does not refetch. This is unchanged from before for mime_type changes as well.
test_coverage: sourceCardExcerptText.test.tsx renders all three surfaces with a fetch stub and an IntersectionObserver stub that fires on observe, then asserts the exact drawn text. Removing `|| showsRaw` is killed by every source row (each body contains a pattern that stripPreviewText alters; the `---` row would become empty and time out in waitFor).
Making showsRawExcerpt ignore file_type (any text/*) is killed by the `document + text/markdown` row.
Making showsRawExcerpt ignore the mime (just `other`) survives, but has no user effect because the surfaces never mount TextThumbnail for other + non-text mimes.
Dropping the trim on the raw path survives (F1).
There is no `document + text/plain` row in the text test proving notes.txt still goes through the cleanup path. Its cleanup is a no-op for plain prose anyway.
